source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. A rare golden monster appears and will flee at any moment: bright, playful and slightly comic chase music, "don't let it escape!". Tempo 172 BPM, 4/4 time, key of E major. Instrumentation: glockenspiel and bright pulse-wave style lead, bouncy slap bass, snappy drums, pizzicato strings, xylophone runs. Form: quick intro, bouncy theme, sillier middle, theme again. Duration: 55 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
